name: Mole Box
description: Holes are passable pits in the grid, numbered in reading order (left to right, top to bottom). A mole box sits on a hole and blocks it like any solid box. Every time you successfully open a box anywhere on the grid, every mole hops to the next-numbered hole and wraps from the last hole back to the first — so the route never changes and two moles can never share a hole. Moles come in Default and Hidden flavours and hold marbles like normal boxes; empty one and that mole is gone for good.
howToPlay: Tap boxes to pour marbles onto the belt as usual. The dirt pits are mole holes. Each tap is one turn: the moles burrow down and pop up at the next hole along the route, which opens and closes the channels above them. A box only opens when there is a clear path from it down past the bottom of the grid, so watch which hole is free before you spend a tap. Moles are boxes too — tap one when it is reachable and it is out of the game. Clear every order to win.
author: Claude
